weather.name: Clear skies
weather.description: Bright and dry, with a light breeze.

weather.name: Overcast
weather.description: A flat grey sky, mild and still.

weather.name: Light rain
weather.description: A soft, steady drizzle that beads on cloaks and darkens the paths.

weather.name: Heavy rain
weather.description: Rain coming down in sheets, with thunder somewhere off over the fields. Nobody is outdoors who can help it.

weather.name: High wind
weather.description: A gusting wind that snatches at papers, hems and awnings.

weather.name: Morning mist
weather.description: Low mist lying over the grounds, muffling sound.

weather.name: Snow
weather.description: Snow falling quietly and settling on the roofs and walls.

weather.name: Sweltering heat
weather.description: Heavy, close heat. Everyone is slow and looking for shade.

events.name: the Lantern Festival
events.description: The University floats paper lanterns on the Physic Garden pond at dusk, each carrying a wish.

events.name: the Midsummer Fair
events.description: Traders, games and dancing fill the market square until late.
